intro.title: Introduction
intro.content: Puzzled ("we", "us", or "our") respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal data. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information when you use our services.

controller.title: Who is responsible for your data
controller.content: Sylphx Limited (company number 16438428, 128 City Road, London EC1V 2NX, United Kingdom) is the controller of your personal data under the UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018.

dataCollection.title: Data We Collect
dataCollection.content: We collect the following types of information:

items.account: Account information: name, email address, and profile picture
items.game: Game data: scores, statistics, streaks, and game history
items.payment: Payment information: processed securely through Stripe
items.technical: Technical data: IP address, browser type, and device information
items.errors: Error reports: when a page or our server fails, we record the error message, stack trace and page path (never the query string, email addresses or anything you typed) in Sylphx Observability, our own error-monitoring service, to find and fix the fault
items.referral: Referral tags: if you arrive through a link that carries campaign tags (utm_ parameters or a referral id, for example from another Sylphx product), and you have accepted analytics cookies, we keep those tags for 30 days in a first-party cookie and store them with your account and subscription if you sign up or subscribe. We use them only to know which link brought you; we do not sell or share them.

items.service: Provide and maintain our gaming services

payments.title: Payments
payments.content: When you subscribe, Stripe processes your payment; we never receive your full card number. We keep a record of your subscription, payments and refunds (amounts, dates and Stripe references) for six years to meet UK tax and accounting law. If you delete your account, these records are kept without your player ID.

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Services
thirdParty.content: We work with trusted third-party services:

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.content: We use essential cookies to maintain your session and preferences. By using our service, you consent to our use of cookies.

items.complain: Complain to the Information Commissioner's Office (ico.org.uk) if you are unhappy with how we handle your data

service.title: Our Service
service.content: Puzzled provides daily puzzle games and challenges. We reserve the right to modify, suspend, or discontinue any part of our service at any time.

accounts.title: User Accounts
accounts.content: When creating an account, you agree to:

items.responsible: Be responsible for all activity under your account

subscriptions.title: Puzzled Plus subscriptions
subscriptions.content: Today's featured puzzle is free. Puzzled Plus is an optional paid subscription that opens every game, the archive of past days, and stats for every game.

items.billing: Prices are shown before you pay and include VAT where it applies. Stripe takes payment when you subscribe and at the start of each monthly or yearly period.
items.renewal: Your subscription renews automatically until you cancel. You can cancel at any time in Settings > Subscription; you keep access until the end of the period you have paid for and are not charged again.
items.cancellation: Cancellation right: you may cancel your first subscription within 14 days of starting it and get a full refund, however much you have played. Cancel in Settings > Subscription or email us.
items.refund: After those 14 days we do not refund part-used periods, except where the law requires it or a fault on our side stopped you from using Puzzled.
items.price: If we change the price, we tell you at least 30 days before it applies to your next renewal, and you can cancel before then.
items.family: A family plan covers the subscriber and up to three people they invite. The subscriber can remove people at any time.
items.statutory: Nothing in these terms affects your statutory rights as a consumer.

items.legal: Use the service only for lawful purposes
items.respect: Respect other users and our community
items.noCheat: Not use cheats, exploits, or automated tools
